# Insurance claims

## Requirements

- Claim decisions must be explained to the policyholder in writing, per the Fair Claims Code.

## Stories

- As a policyholder, I want to upload photos of the damage so that my claim has proof.
- As a policyholder, I want to track the status of my claim so that I know what happens next.
- As a policyholder, I want a written explanation of why my claim was accepted or refused so that I understand the decision.
- As a policyholder, I want to speak to an adjuster so that I can ask questions.
